name: EPIC 205982177
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.5 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205982177 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.529596 (16th-84th percentiles 8.176908-8.910761), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,042 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.96 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,777 K at its surface.
